meta.name: deck-ljg-present
meta.description: 把 outline 1:1 铸成色块大字宣言 deck, 原文不动只做美化。三档主题 black / red / yellow

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大纲一键转成大字宣言风格幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速把文字大纲变成视觉冲击力强的演示文稿。
copy.tagline_en: Turn outlines into bold statement decks with one click
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn text outlines into visually impactful presentations.

howto.what: Claude会把你的大纲或Markdown原样做成一套大字色块风格的HTML幻灯片。不改原文、不重排，只做分页与排版；整篇一种主题色（黑/红/黄），输出可直接翻页的HTML文件。
howto.when: 当用户给出大纲或Markdown，并要求做成宣言式大字幻灯片时触发，例如提到“宣言”、“deck”、“把大纲做成幻灯片”等。

say.text: 把这份大纲做成红色主题的宣言式幻灯片
say.note: Claude会按大纲原样生成一整套HTML翻页deck。

say.text: 用黑色主题把这篇文章的要点做成大字宣言页
say.note: 会自动拆页并保持原文顺序。

say.text: 把下面这个列表做成黄色主题的幻灯片，强调的词标出来
say.note: 只保留红色高亮，原文不重写。

howto.what_en: Turns the user's outline/Markdown into a big-type, color-block HTML slideshow. Text is never rewritten or reordered; only pagination and styling are applied. One theme color (black/red/yellow) per deck; output is a single self-contained HTML file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides an outline/Markdown and asks for a manifesto-style large-type slideshow—for example saying “make this a deck”, “宣言”, or “turn this outline into slides”.

say_en.text: Turn this outline into a red-theme manifesto slideshow.
say_en.note: Claude builds the full HTML deck from the outline as-is.

say_en.text: Make a black-theme large-type deck from these bullet points.
say_en.note: It splits pages and keeps the original order.

say_en.text: Use yellow theme for this list, highlight the key terms.
say_en.note: Only highlights are added; text is not rewritten.
